Name: Trendy Haley
Author: candidus42
Description:
Configuration parameters in config.json, also configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:
HairColor - Haley's hair color for the season. Change it if you don't like the random value.
HairDyeInterval - How often Haley dyes her hair. Options are OncePerSeason, TwicePerSeason, OncePerWeek.
ColorIsFading - Sets whether Haley's hair color is fading to gray during the season. Default is true.
AlphaBlend - Use alpha blending for Haley's hair so she gets her original blonde back during the season. Default is false.
SpouseLookAlike - Haley's spouse has the same hair color. Doesn't work exactly if AlphaBlend is true since the farmer sprite doesn't have a hair texture for blending. Default is false.

Source code on [url=https://github.com/mus-candidus/TrendyHaley]GitHub[/url]

Downloads.Description: Last version compatible with SDV 1.5 . Minimum SMAPI version is 3.14 now, fixed SMAPI deprecation warnings for future compatibility. No longer compatible with SDV 1.4 .
